List available local Agent Skills with their IDs, names, and descriptions. Use this to discover which skill applies before loading it.

set -euo pipefail
export LC_COLLATE=C
root=".agents/skills"
json_escape() {{ local s="$1"; s=${{s//\\/\\\\}}; s=${{s//\"/\\\"}}; s=${{s//$'\n'/\\n}}; s=${{s//$'\r'/\\r}}; s=${{s//$'\t'/\\t}}; printf "%s" "$s"; }}
trim() {{ local s="$1"; s="${{s#"${{s%%[![:space:]]*}}"}}"; s="${{s%"${{s##*[![:space:]]}}"}}"; printf "%s" "$s"; }}
unquote() {{ local s; s="$(trim "$1")"; if (( ${{#s}} >= 2 )); then if [[ ${{s:0:1}} == '"' && ${{s: -1}} == '"' ]]; then s=${{s:1:${{#s}}-2}}; elif [[ ${{s:0:1}} == "'" && ${{s: -1}} == "'" ]]; then s=${{s:1:${{#s}}-2}}; fi; fi; printf "%s" "$s"; }}
printf "["
first=1
shopt -s nullglob
for file in "$root"/*/SKILL.md; do
  dir=${{file%/SKILL.md}}; id=${{dir##*/}}; name=""; description=""; in_frontmatter=0; frontmatter_closed=0
  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    if (( in_frontmatter == 0 )); then
      if [[ "$line" == "---" ]]; then in_frontmatter=1; continue; fi
      break
    fi
    if [[ "$line" == "---" ]]; then frontmatter_closed=1; break; fi
    case "$line" in
      name:*) name=$(unquote "${{line#name:}}") ;;
      description:*) description=$(unquote "${{line#description:}}") ;;
    esac
  done < "$file"
  reason=""
  [[ -n "$name" ]] || reason="name is required"
  (( ${{#description}} >= 1 && ${{#description}} <= 1024 )) || reason="description must be 1-1024 characters"
  (( frontmatter_closed == 1 )) || reason="frontmatter closing delimiter is required"
  [[ "$name" == "$id" ]] || reason="name must match directory"
  (( ${{#name}} >= 1 && ${{#name}} <= 64 )) || reason="name must be 1-64 characters"
  [[ "$name" =~ ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ ]] || reason="name has invalid characters or hyphen placement"
  if [[ -n "$reason" ]]; then
    printf 'skipping invalid Agent Skill: %s: %s\n' "$file" "$reason" >&2
    continue
  fi
  if (( first == 0 )); then printf ","; fi; first=0
  printf '{{"id":"%s","name":"%s","description":"%s"}}' "$(json_escape "$id")" "$(json_escape "$name")" "$(json_escape "$description")"
done
printf "]\n"
